authors: T. F. Gallagher, W. E. Cooke
title: Fine-structure intervals and polarizabilities of highly excited d states of K
method: radio-frequency resonance between nd3/2 and nd5/2 in a weak dc field, detected by state-selective field ionization; zero-field interval from a fit in E^2 and E^4 (Eq. 7)
conversion: Rows with {'l': '2'}: the level has j = 5/2 (given in the label only).
caveats: Only fine-structure differences, no absolute energies.
